test_ScenarioConfigTest: test the ScenarioConfigTest class that validates scenario config integrity
test_test_has_description: test that every scenario config has a non-empty description
test_test_has_valid_substrate: test that every scenario references a valid substrate from AVAILABLE_SUBSTRATES
test_test_bots_compatible: test that all bots assigned to roles are compatible with the substrate and role
test_test_no_duplicates: test that no two scenario names share the same config object
